_: Headshots that are PHOTOGRAPHS rather than pre-cut layers. `file` is the untouched photo and `matte` its alpha, keyed off the studio backdrop by scripts/matte.mjs so the arch's floral paper shows behind her; the app multiplies the two and then clips to the arch. Two crops of one frame are two entries sharing a `file` and a `matte` - the script keys each photograph once and both builds inline it once. `tolerance` overrides the keyer's default for one photograph - the dress is a white-on-black print close enough to the seamless that the default walks in through it - and is only ever read by the script, never by the app. `fits` is a placement PER LAYOUT, saved from the Headshot Positions tool (claude.ai/artifact/SWY6VnFWkQ8fib6RAZE3UU): zoom is a multiple of the scale that covers the arch, offsets are artboard px. Per layout because the two arches are not the same shape - the mirror's is 554px wide against the original's 556 - and because a crop that frames her nicely against one is not obliged to against the other. A layout with no entry falls back to `standard`. Every shot here has been framed in both. One source of truth - the app builds HEADSHOTS from this and build-single.mjs inlines the same paths.
